'''Alex Twist''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[August 2001 Colorado Springs tournament (11 August)]] on 11 August 2001 with [[Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place|BHBM Beatdown (rated 1575)]] and EBO pods, according to Patrick Napier's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2848">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-16-colorado-springs-a-dark-comeback-8-11-01d2848/ colorado-springs-a-dark-comeback-8-11-01], DeckTech (Patrick "Pappy" Napier, 16 August 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-16-colorado-springs-a-dark-comeback-8-11-01d2848/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
